title: TypeScript library deployment diagram
description: How @utv/core runs: tsc compiles it into an ES module, which runs in-process inside the caller's Node.js application and reads only the zone-rule file the caller names. Nothing in the repository shows the package published to a registry: package.json has no publish configuration, there is no release procedure, and every version in the CHANGELOG is unreleased.

nodes.name: Caller's machine
nodes.description: Wherever the application runs. The library reads nothing from it but the rule file it is given: not the clock, the time zone, the tz database or the locale.

nodes.name: Caller's Node.js application
nodes.description: The application that imports @utv/core. The library runs in this process as ordinary function calls; it starts no process, thread or server of its own.

nodes.name: Zone-rule bundle file
nodes.description: A JSON file in the format of conformance/rules/demo-zones.json (a ruleSet identity, validFrom, validUntil and per-zone transitions), named by the caller. It is a file, not a database server.
nodes.condition: Only for zoned operations: ZoneRules.load(path). A caller may instead pass the bundle's text to ZoneRules.parse, and then no file is read.

artifacts.name: @utv/core 0.3.0 (dist/src/index.js and index.d.ts)
artifacts.description: tsc -p . compiles src/ (and test/) into dist/; package.json's main is dist/src/index.js and types dist/src/index.d.ts, an ES module (type: module) with no runtime dependencies.

relationships.description: Runs the caller's application, and the library inside it.
ZoneRules.load reads the file with node:fs readFileSync; the library does no other I/O.
